Naviamp v2.11.0

Naviamp 2.11.0 expands Aurral discovery into a complete browsing and request hub, adds signed Flatpak installation and updates for Linux, and improves playback, internet radio and Android TV controls.

- Explore full Aurral recommendations, catalog search, artist and release pages, Trending charts and persistent request status from one discovery hub.
- Install and update the Linux app through the official signed Flatpak repository.
- Keep TV controls visible, choose new artwork layouts, and get more reliable playback and internet-radio metadata.

Other changes

- New artwork layout settings and an option to keep TV controls visible.
- More accurate internet-radio titles and artwork, with useful TV stream controls.
- Playback, paused-position, album-profile, lyrics and Android startup fixes.
- Clearer repeat states, correctly placed menus/tooltips, and updated translations.

Known limits

- The signed Flatpak remains v2.10.0 until its v2.11.0 update can be signed; direct Linux downloads include v2.11.0.
- Album Play-button Gapless and TV queue-end Autoplay reports remain under investigation.
- Existing Android/Windows presentation and macOS/Linux performance or acceptance investigations continue.
- Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta; direct desktop downloads remain unsigned and iOS sideloading requires signing.

Thanks

- Welcome first-time contributor @crsthn-slv for radio, TV, playback and lyrics improvements, testing, and the Brazilian Portuguese translation.
- Welcome first-time contributor @sewnie for reporting the Android startup failure when the Cast module is unavailable.

Download: https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/releases/tag/v2.11.0
